description: Seed row 1 catalog with a localeMatchSupplier returning matchFor(Locale und-Latn). localeLookupFor takes the lookup locale from the MATCH — its locale, or the match's own fallbackLocale when the match is NONE (DefaultStrings.java:2449-2453) — so resolution starts at fr rather than at und-Latn. This is the 'intentional lookup difference for supplied matches' half of the clause.
